decisions.reason: Specialized sports flooring is outside the firm's trend-led residential focus and likely falls short of the aspiration set by core flooring sales, so management will drop it.
Arenas represent a small niche with limited repeat demand, and its results likely fail to meet the firm's performance aspirations, triggering problemistic search and discontinuation.
As a second mobile arena system, it creates overlap and is even less likely to meet aspirations, so the firm will drop it to free resources.
The chevron pattern aligns directly with the firm's strategy of trend-led, style-oriented premium flooring and is close to its established offer, so it is likely meeting aspirations and will be kept.
This very narrow sports finish is far from the firm's core interior flooring customers and likely performs below aspirations, leading to its removal.
As an accessory tied to the sports flooring line, its viability depends on those products; with the sports systems being dropped, the skirting is also likely to be discontinued.
